name: Cheaters Run
description: Cheaters Run is a barren stretch of coast that lies south of the Royal Valley, and it offers a way to and from the Ashlands that avoids the Southern Hive. Nothing grows there, there is no water, and acid rain falls at times. Iron Spiders and large fishman patrols roam the shore, Skin Bandits hold a ruined village in the east, and old police machines guard a dead fishing village and arrest anyone who enters.
